body: Jane has been incredible with our 6-year-old. She explains every exercise to us so we can keep practicing at home, and we've seen real progress in just a few months -- he's using full sentences now instead of single words.
We needed someone who actually knew AAC devices, not just speech basics. Jane got our daughter's device set up and working within two sessions and trained our whole family on how to use it at home.
Great therapist, very patient with my son. Only reason it's not five stars is scheduling can be tight since she's in high demand -- worth the wait though.

Finding a BCBA who actually had availability felt impossible until we found Lonestar. The RBT assigned to our daughter has been a great fit, and the monthly progress reviews actually show data, not just vague updates.

In-home sessions have made a huge difference for us -- our son does better in his own environment than he ever did at a clinic. The team communicates clearly and adjusts the plan when something isn't working.
Solid program and knowledgeable staff. Billing with insurance took a few calls to sort out at the start but has run smoothly since.

My son struggled with reading for years and nothing seemed to help until we started here. His Orton-Gillingham tutor identified exactly where the gap was, and he's gone from dreading reading to picking up books on his own.

The diagnostic assessment at intake was more thorough than anything the school did. We finally understood what we were actually dealing with, and the twice-weekly sessions have paid off within a semester.
